---
name: update-full-docs
description: Update the documentation to reflect any changes in the code, fixing documentation drift
---
Considering the hierarchical documentation system described in #file:../copilot-instructions.md use #tool:agent/runSubagent to assign each agent a module or set of modules and the README files therein, grouped by context and complexity. Each subagent is responsible for reading the documentation assigned to it, comparing it to the current state of the code, and updating the documentation to reflect any changes in the code, fixing documentation drift. If in-code documentation has drifted, the subagent should update it as well. The subagents should also ensure that the documentation is clear, concise, and accurate, and that it follows any established style guidelines. You MUST issue the agents such that they work in PARALLEL. Their work should be independent. Once all subagents complete their work, review their response and update the documentation entry point #file:../copilot-instructions.md to reflect any major changes which warrant it. Do this last stop only if required, and only if the changes are relevant to the documentation entry point.
